exposure: Postnatal weight gain during the first 6 weeks
cohort: The study included 90 premature infants who underwent ophthalmoscopy at Hospital Universitari Vall d'Hebron in Barcelona.
finding: Gestational age and postnatal weight gain during the first 6 weeks of life were significant predictors of the need for treatment in infants with retinopathy of prematurity, while birth weight was not.
